title: Recorded invocation reader
responsibility: Reads recorded function input/output cases while distinguishing missing or malformed evidence.

inputs.name: artifactCases.document
inputs.description: Any artifact value passed to the reader; a non-object produces a gap. A `function-invocations` document must use schema version 1, nonempty `unitId` and `symbol` strings of at most 200 characters, 1–64 calls, and nonempty call names of at most 160 characters, with each call containing `input` and exactly one of `output` or `error`; other kinds yield one observation only when at least one of `input`/`inputs`/`request` and one of `output`/`outputs`/`response` is present.

inputs.name: artifactCases.unit
inputs.description: Optional unit identifier used only to filter recorded-invocation documents; a different `unitId` produces a gap, while legacy observations are not filtered. Defaults to undefined, so omitting it leaves valid recorded invocations unfiltered.

outputs.name: caseForm
outputs.description: The reader's recorded-call format constants. They set schema version 1, kind `function-invocations`, a 64-case maximum, and a 160-character case-name maximum.

outputs.name: artifactCases
outputs.description: Tagged result containing either an explanatory gap, rows for valid recorded calls, or one legacy observation row. Recorded documents require schema version 1, 1–64 calls, nonempty unit and symbol strings up to 200 characters, and call names from 1–160 characters with `input` plus exactly one of `output` or `error`; legacy fields use the first present alias in `input`/`inputs`/`request` and `output`/`outputs`/`response`, retaining values such as false, zero, null, and empty arrays.

examples.why: Its cases are not in the recorded form.
